d: FAW Middle East Automible Trading FZE is a division of the Fortune 500 FAW China Group Corporation, we are a fast-growing automotive brand preparing our full-scale launch across Middle East and Africa, we are delightly to welcome new talents to join us from all over the world!

We are seeking a results-driven and strategic Marketing Manager to lead our brand positioning, product launches, and lead generation campaigns in GCC countries. You will oversee multi-channel marketing initiatives that drive brand awareness, showroom traffic, and vehicle sales across target markets.
q: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
Experience: 5+ years of marketing experience, with at least 3 years in the automotive sector.
Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of the automotive sales funnel, dealership operations, and consumer buying journeys.
Digital Expertise: Proven track record in managing digital acquisition channels, CRM platforms, and marketing automation tools.
Analytical Skills: Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Power BI, Tableau) to measure ROI and optimize campaigns.
Project & Vendor Management: Experience managing external creative agencies, PR firms, and event vendors within strict timelines and budgets.
Communication: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills in English [and local language, if applicable].
Experience launching Vehicles or connected car technologies.
Familiarity with B2B fleet marketing in addition to B2C retail marketing.
language: Fluency in Chinese is a plus.
r: Marketing Strategy & Execution: Develop and execute comprehensive annual and quarterly marketing plans aligned with business and sales targets.
Product Launches: Lead end-to-end go-to-market strategies for new vehicle models, updates, and automotive technologies.
Brand & Content Management: Ensure consistent brand messaging across all touchpoints, including video production, digital brochures, and website content.
Events & Auto Shows: Plan and manage major auto shows, regional test-drive events, dealership activations, and experiential marketing campaigns.
Dealer Network Support: Collaborate closely with regional dealerships to provide co-op marketing materials, local campaign support, and sales enablement tools.
Budget & ROI Tracking: Manage the marketing budget effectively and analyze campaign performance using KPIs such as conversion rates, and market share growth.
Market Intelligence: Monitor automotive industry trends, competitor activities, and consumer behavior to identify new growth opportunities.

d: Tivoli Hotels & Resorts is a collection of luxury hotels and resorts set in idyllic beaches and cosmopolitan locations, from iconic destinations in Europe to the Middle East, and from Brazil to Asia. We are timeless, dedicated, and distinctive — evoking a time when hotel stays were grand experiences and travel meant life slowed down for a while.

Founded in 1933, Tivoli’s long-standing heritage is built on extraordinary service, authentic local experiences, and a genuine dedication to the art of hospitality. If you share a passion for making every guest feel they have arrived somewhere truly special, Tivoli is where your story belongs.

To provide prompt, professional, and courteous food and beverage service while creating memorable dining experiences for every guest. As a Hospitality Ambassador for Tivoli Hotels & Resorts, the Waitress is responsible for ensuring guests receive attentive, efficient, and personalized service that reflects the hotel's luxury standards.

The Waitress plays a key role in guest satisfaction by delivering exceptional service, maintaining product knowledge, and working closely with the Food & Beverage team to ensure smooth daily operations.
